node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 coordinate colored-quotient resultant compiler
node.closure: deck descent of the colored quartic and explicit cubic-norm resultants in the coordinate parity spaces
node.statement: In the coordinate order-two orientation, the four colored roots form the pullback c(W) of a squarefree quotient quadratic, hence are the complete edge pairs at two right pole-graph vertices. Writing P_S(T)=p_S(T^2), the positive partial resultants are Res_Y(p_S,(A_2Y+A_0)^2-WYB_1^2), and the negative partial resultants are Res_Y(p_S,W(B_2Y+B_0)^2-YA_1^2). They equal K_5^2 c and R_7^2/c in the exact cleared sense. This is an explicit 8/7-dimensional univariate compiler, not an orientation deletion.
